faq.q: Why is my refrigerator running but not cooling?
faq.a: The usual causes are a failed evaporator fan, a defrost fault that iced the coils or dirty condenser coils; the technician tests each one.

faq.q: How long does a refrigerator repair take?
faq.a: Most repairs take one to two hours once the technician is on site.
Yes. We repair freestanding, counter-depth and built-in models.

faq.q: Should I repair or replace an older refrigerator?
faq.a: The technician compares the repair price with replacement so you can make the call.

faq.q: What should I do before the technician arrives?
faq.a: Keep the doors closed and move the most perishable food to a cooler with ice.

faqClosing: Still have a question about your refrigerator? Our FAQ page covers the service call, scheduling and what happens on the visit.
